cues.en: I'd like to take a moment to discuss other ways of evaluating LLM performance capabilities that have
cues.zh: 花點時間，討論其他評估 LLM 表現與能力的方式，

cues.en: nothing to do with the model, logits or softmax probabilities, or even working with the model itself.
cues.zh: 不涉及 logits、softmax 機率，甚至不必直接操作模型。

cues.en: The thing is, these llms do not simply exist on their own in some abstract academic setting.
cues.zh: LLM 並不是獨自存在於抽象學術環境。

cues.en: They are developed by companies and organizations that have particular goals for developing AI, which is usually to have some commercial or application value.
cues.zh: 它們由公司、組織開發，帶著特定目標，通常是商業或應用價值。

cues.en: And so in this video, I will just briefly mention several of the important indicators of the performance
cues.zh: 這支簡短介紹幾個重要的

cues.en: of an LLM that can be quantitative but are not technical.
cues.zh: LLM 表現指標，可以量化，但不是技術性的。

cues.en: And I'd like to start with a meme.
cues.zh: 先從迷因開始。

cues.en: This is perhaps a little bit cheesy, but the point I'm trying to express here is that for application purposes, nobody cares about some quantitative eval score.
cues.zh: 也許有點老套，但想表達的是，實際應用時，沒人在乎某個量化評估分數。

cues.en: You know, if an AI helps some biochemist Biochemists develop a new medication that helps a lot of people.
cues.zh: 例如，AI 幫生物化學家開發新藥，幫助許多人，

cues.en: No one will care whether that model had a low or a high mauve score.
cues.zh: 誰會在乎模型的 MAUVE 高或低？

cues.en: So and with that in mind, let me now seed your imagination with some other useful metrics of the utility
cues.zh: 記住這點，接著用其他有用的效益指標，激發你的想像。

cues.en: of some of the list items that I will present on this slide are quantitative in the sense that you can measure them and attach numbers to them.
cues.zh: 投影片列出的有些是量化的，可以測量、賦予數字。

cues.en: Others are actually more qualitative, so I suppose technically they should belong in the next section of the course.
cues.zh: 其他較質性，嚴格來說，也許該放下一章。

cues.en: But I hope you will forgive me for mixing some topics.
cues.zh: 希望你原諒我把主題混在一起。

cues.en: Anyway, one metric is usage, which you can quantify as for example, the number of people actively
cues.zh: 總之，一個指標是使用量，例如有多少人積極

cues.en: using a particular LLM, or perhaps signing up for an account that is necessary to use an LLM.
cues.zh: 使用某個 LLM，或註冊使用所需的帳號。

cues.en: Maybe it's the number of downloads if it's a publicly available model and you can quantify user satisfaction,
cues.zh: 公開模型也許看下載量；也能量化使用者滿意度，

cues.en: you can quantify how helpful the users report the LMS to be many of the big LM development companies
cues.zh: 以及使用者回報模型有多大幫助。許多大型開發公司，

cues.en: like Google, meta, OpenAI, Microsoft are for profit organizations.
cues.zh: 像 Google、Meta、OpenAI、微軟，都是營利組織。

cues.en: So they are concerned with how much money they can make from their LMS, as well as how much media attention they're getting.
cues.zh: 所以關注模型賺多少錢，以及獲得多少媒體注意。

cues.en: Both news, traditional media and also social media.
cues.zh: 包括新聞、傳統媒體與社群媒體。

cues.en: With this phrase app ecosystem, I'm referring to how the LM is integrated into third party apps.
cues.zh: app ecosystem，應用生態系，是指 LLM 如何整合到第三方應用。

cues.en: For example, how many people are using APIs to access an LM through some third party website or like a phone app?
cues.zh: 例如多少人透過 API，在第三方網站或手機 App 使用 LLM。

cues.en: Of course, an important quantification is the cost of training and also using LMS, and that can include
cues.zh: 當然，訓練與使用成本，也是重要量化指標，包括

cues.en: both the initial cost of pre-training and fine tuning, costs of purchasing new GPUs, staff costs, energy usage costs and also ongoing costs.
cues.zh: 初始預訓練、微調、新 GPU、員工、能源，以及持續營運成本。

cues.en: For example, the cost per token to do a forward pass.
cues.zh: 例如，前向傳播每個詞元的成本。

cues.en: And I mentioned earlier in the course that training a modern frontier, GPT from scratch is somewhere around a few tens of millions of US dollars.
cues.zh: 課程前面提過，從零訓練現代前沿 GPT，大約需要幾千萬美元。

cues.en: Relatedly, many people are justifiably concerned about the absolutely mammoth amount of energy that is consumed by llms.
cues.zh: 同樣地，許多人合理地關注 LLM 驚人的能源消耗。

cues.en: Training these models requires a gigantic amount of energy, which means that LLM usage also generates a lot of pollution.
cues.zh: 訓練需要龐大能源，也表示使用 LLM 會產生很多污染。

cues.en: And that is another dimension to think about as a metric of LLM development and usage.
cues.zh: 這也是思考 LLM 開發與使用的另一個衡量面向。

cues.en: Well, that is certainly not a complete, exhaustive list, but I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 這當然不是完整清單，但應該理解意思了。

cues.en: The point is that although technical evaluations of capabilities and world knowledge are important and
cues.zh: 重點是，技術能力、世界知識評估很重要，

cues.en: we need to continue developing better eval methods, there are also other important ways to think about
cues.zh: 也必須持續改善方法，但思考 LLM 的

cues.en: the costs, the benefits, and the impacts of llms that have nothing to do with token logits.
cues.zh: 成本、效益、影響，還有其他重要方式，與詞元 logits 無關。
